app.name: SWAMS
app.tagline: Smart workflow and attendance for Nepal's SMEs

state.offline: You're offline — changes are saved on this device

access.title: You don't have access
access.body: Your HR admin or workspace owner can grant it from Settings → Roles.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that page
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the feature hasn't shipped yet.

home.sampleBody: The company-wide panels on this page — attendance trend, department rates, insights and the industry benchmark — are served by demo fixtures. The analytics endpoints behind them are contract request 25 and are not built yet; the punch card, tasks and rail below are the live flows.

preview.body: This screen shows sample content — the live feature isn't connected yet.
preview.callBody: Participants and chat are demo data and no call is placed. Microphone, camera and screen share are this browser's own devices, streamed nowhere — the provider adapter and the meeting token are still to come.

auth.title: Sign in to SWAMS
auth.subtitle: Attendance, leave and work — for your whole team.
auth.mfaSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your work email and we'll send you a reset link.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way.
auth.demoBody: Mock sign-in is on — any valid email plus a password of 8+ characters works. Use these to explore each portal:
auth.personaHint: Each role is its own demo account — pick one to see that board.
auth.demoMfaHint: Triggers the 6-digit code step — enter any 6 digits.
auth.demoAutofill: Demo credentials are filled in for you — switch role above to sign in as someone else.

error.signInFailed: That email or password didn't match. Try again.
error.sendFailed: Couldn't send the reset link. Try again.

login.brandTagline: Smart Workspace and Attendance Management System
login.brandBody: Attendance, tasks, leaves, messaging — everything your team needs, in one unified platform.
login.welcomeBackSub: Sign in to access your workspace

wizard.title: Set up your organization
wizard.subtitle: Four quick steps — you can change these later in Settings.
wizard.sitesHint: Places where people clock in — add one per office or branch.
wizard.sitesEmpty: No sites yet — add your first one above.
wizard.calendarBsHint: Official calendar of Nepal — shown as the default.
wizard.fiscalYearHint: Nepali fiscal year starts in Shrawan (mid-July), e.g. 07-16.
wizard.reviewNote: Check the details, then finish setup.

done.title: Your workspace is ready
done.body: {{name}} is set up. Invite your team next.

install.title: Install SWAMS
install.body: Add it to your home screen for one-tap access — it works offline too.
